CustomField.description: This field references the field Model Grade on the related WC Credit Decision record.
CustomField.formula:
IF( Rush_Request__c = TRUE, '1',
IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Owner.UserType,'Standard'), CONTAINS(Broker_Account__r.Name, 'Quick Bridge')), '2',
IF( CONTAINS(Broker_Account__r.Name, 'Lendio'), '3',
IF( NOT(CONTAINS(Broker_Account__r.Name, 'Snap')), '4',
IF( CONTAINS(Broker_Account__r.Name, 'Snap'), '5',
'NA' )))))
